title: The gourd that must be lifted
odia:
ନିଲଜ ଲାଉ
ଟେକି ଟାକି ଦେଲେ ପିଢାକୁ ଯାଉ।
literal_meaning: Shameless gourd! When lifted up, you go onto the thatched roof.
meaning_odia: ଲାଉକୁ ନିଲଜ ବୋଲି ସମ୍ବୋଧନ କରି କଥକ କହୁଛନ୍ତି, ଟେକି ଦେଲେ ସେ ଚାଳକୁ ଯାଏ। ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟର ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ଉପରକୁ ଉଠିବା ଉପରେ ଏକ କଟାକ୍ଷ। ଏଠାରେ ପିଢ଼ାର ଅର୍ଥ ଘରର ଚାଳ। ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଦରକାର ହେବାକୁ ନିଜେ ଲଜ୍ଜାର ବିଷୟ ବୋଲି ଧରାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: The gourd is addressed like a person and mocked for reaching its support through someone else’s lifting. Our editorial reading focuses on dependence on that help. The force of the taunt belongs to the speaker; the image alone does not make assistance a moral failing.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A teammate waits for others to initiate every step before joining in. An impatient colleague recalls the gourd that moves upward when lifted, making their frustration audible.
cultural_context: The verse personifies a gourd being lifted onto a thatched roof. Its teasing voice makes dependence on another person’s help the point of the image.
